description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome back to the market this impressive five bedroom property, ideally located on the popular Lesbury Road in Heaton.

This spacious family home offers five generously sized double bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a large kitchen/diner, providing plenty of versatile living and entertaining space.

The property is perfectly positioned to benefit from Heaton-s excellent range of local amenities, as well as superb transport links providing easy access to Newcastle City Centre and surrounding areas.

To arrange your viewing, contact the My Property Box team today.
